title: matra Clusters, schema 2.x
description: A document's sentences grouped by the similarity of their embeddings: the serde form of `matra::domain::Clusters`, from `matra::clusters`. Model opinion, not structure: the scores belong to the embedder `provenance.parameters.embedder` names. A cluster is a connected component of the graph of sentence pairs whose cosine similarity is at least the threshold, so co-membership is transitive and never pairwise similarity; a sentence in no cluster had no edge. Schema 2.x, read by the same rules as the document schema: ignore fields you do not recognize, treat every string set as open (`method` among them), and reject a major you do not know. Every key listed here is always present. Each method scores on its own scale, so a score compares only with another score from the same method.

provenance.description: The document's provenance, with the method that ran and the parameters that shaped the result.

clusters.description: The clusters, ordered by their smallest member.

edges.description: Every sentence pair whose similarity cleared the threshold, ordered by `a`, then `b`.

members.description: Sentence indices (positions among the document's sentences), ascending; at least two.

SimilarityEdge.description: A pair of sentences whose similarity cleared the threshold, `a < b`.

score.description: Their cosine similarity, in the embedder's geometry.
